title: reconcile MAX_HAVE truncation: caller cannot detect partial have-set
description: core/group_log/reconcile.rs:55-66: when have grows to MAX_HAVE=1000, iteration stops silently. The returned set is indistinguishable from an exhaustive scan. A peer diverged by >1000 entries needs multiple reconciliation rounds with no protocol signal that more rounds are needed. For large divergences, convergence degrades sub-linearly and gossipsub is polluted with repeated reconcile messages. Fix: return a boolean 'truncated' flag or a cursor; document the multi-round convergence requirement explicitly.
